description: Bounded activation-sensitivity experiments made before selecting the updated educational scenario. All use the same 330758-source forward operator, 2ms upstroke and APDfield. The chosen model was selected for a less exaggerated QRS notch; these are not independent biological validation results. Literal physical7/16mm extent alternatives and seven-region alternatives were not adopted.
parameterTupleMeaning: angle radians in the retained anatomical frame
note: The selected twelve-site case uses normalized coordinate offsets ±.07, not exact7mm offsets; original experiment naming has been corrected. Seven-site alternatives include an assumed RV-facing septal target and were not adopted.
